subject: DI04000321

body.en:
Definition

A three-phase AC machine exchanges electrical and mechanical energy using three-phase windings;its synchronous or asynchronous behaviour is determined by the rotor-field speed relationship and excitation mechanism.

Classification / scope

  • Induction/asynchronous:squirrel-cage and wound-rotor/slip-ring types;synchronous:wound-field,permanent-magnet and synchronous-reluctance families.
  • Classify further by motor/generator duty,rotor construction,cooling,mounting,enclosure and supply/control method;do not confuse an application with a constructional type.

Explanation and exam-ready understanding

  • An induction motor normally operates below field speed in motoring;an induction generator operates above field speed with excitation supplied by an appropriate source.
  • A synchronous machine locks its rotor field to the rotating stator field in steady operation;motor/generator describes power direction,not a completely different electromagnetic law.

Read each definition first,then identify the machine family and stated model assumptions.Do not transfer a formula across incompatible connections or sign conventions.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Three-phase AC machine three-phase windingsથી electrical/mechanical energy exchange કરે છે;rotor-field speed relation/excitation પ્રમાણે તેનું synchronous અથવા asynchronous વર્તન નક્કી થાય છે.

વર્ગીકરણ / વ્યાપ

  • Induction/asynchronous:squirrel-cage તથા wound-rotor/slip-ring;synchronous:wound-field,permanent-magnet/synchronous-reluctance families.
  • આગળ motor/generator duty,rotor construction,cooling,mounting,enclosure/supply-controlથી classify કરો;applicationને constructional type નમાનો.

સમજણ તથા પરીક્ષાલક્ષી ઉપયોગ

  • Induction motor motoringમાં સામાન્ય field speedથી નીચે ચાલે;induction generator field speedથી ઉપર appropriate excitation સાથે ચાલે.
  • Synchronous machineમાં steady operation દરમિયાન rotor field stator field સાથે lock થાય;motor/generator power direction બતાવે,સાવ જુદો electromagnetic law નહીં.

પહેલાં વ્યાખ્યા વાંચી machine family તથા modelની ધારણાઓ ઓળખો.જુદાં connections/sign conventionsમાં formula અંધ રીતે નલગાડો.

body.en:
Definition

A three-phase squirrel-cage induction motor has a three-phase distributed stator winding and a rotor whose conducting bars are permanently shorted by end rings,so rotor resistance is not normally externally adjustable.

Construction / parts and their purpose

  1. The frame supports a laminated stator with three winding groups displaced120electrical degrees;the terminal box brings out the appropriate winding ends.
  2. Insulated slots,coil groups and wedges locate conductors and maintain dielectric/mechanical integrity.
  3. Rotor laminations carry flux;bars and end rings form a robust closed secondary circuit without commutator or slip rings.
  4. The air gap couples flux while allowing motion;bearings and end shields maintain concentricity and alignment.
  5. Shaft,fan,enclosure,earth terminal and nameplate support load transmission,cooling,safe installation and rating identification.

Working / cause-and-effect sequence

  1. A balanced supply creates a rotating field;relative motion induces rotor current and electromagnetic torque.
  2. The cage accelerates until torque balances load plus losses at nonzero slip under normal motoring.

Explanation and exam-ready understanding

  • Skewed bars can reduce cogging,noise and some harmonic effects,but do not eliminate every torque pulsation.Rotor bar material/shape also affect starting current and running losses.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Three-phase squirrel-cage induction motorમાં distributed three-phase stator winding અને end ringsથી permanently shorted rotor bars હોય છે;rotor resistance સામાન્ય રીતે બહારથી બદલી શકાતો નથી.

Construction / ભાગો તથા તેમનું કાર્ય

  1. Frameમાં laminated stator તથા120electrical degrees displaced three winding groups હોય;terminal box યોગ્ય ends આપે.
  2. Insulated slots,coil groups/wedges conductorsને સ્થિર રાખી dielectric/mechanical integrity આપે.
  3. Rotor laminations flux વહાવે;bars/end rings commutator/slip rings વિના robust closed secondary બનાવે.
  4. Air gap flux coupling/rotation આપે;bearings/end shields concentricity/alignment જાળવે.
  5. Shaft,fan,enclosure,earth terminal/nameplate load transmission,cooling,safe installation/rating identification આપે.

Working / કારણ તથા પરિણામનો ક્રમ

  1. Balanced supply rotating field બનાવે;relative motion rotor current/torque induce કરે.
  2. Normal motoringમાં nonzero slip પર torque load/losses બરાબર થાય ત્યાં સુધી cage accelerate કરે.

સમજણ તથા પરીક્ષાલક્ષી ઉપયોગ

  • Skewed bars cogging,noise/કેટલાક harmonics ઘટાડે,બધા torque pulsations નહીં.Bar material/shape starting current/running lossesને અસર કરે.

body.en:
Definition

A slip-ring induction motor has an insulated wound rotor connected to external terminals through slip rings and brushes,allowing a designed external rotor resistance to influence starting and speed.

Construction / parts and their purpose

  1. Three-phase stator,laminated core and frame resemble a cage motor with appropriate ratings.
  2. Rotor slots contain insulated distributed windings,usually with internal star point.
  3. Three slip rings,brush holders and an enclosed resistance starter connect the rotor circuit;guards prevent contact with rotating/live parts.
  4. Bearings,cooling and any brush-lifting/shorting device must follow the actual manufacturer design.

Working / cause-and-effect sequence

  1. Start with the approved resistance stage to limit current and develop suitable torque.
  2. Progressively cut out resistance as the motor accelerates;normal low-loss running generally uses a shorted rotor circuit.
  3. Never open the energised rotor circuit casually;induced voltage and arcing can be hazardous.

Explanation and exam-ready understanding

  • The rotor is commonly three-phase star connected with three accessible ends;the external circuit is part of the rotor,not a resistor inserted in the stator supply.
  • Added resistance increases the slip at maximum torque and can improve starting torque up to the proper value;it dissipates power and does not make running speed loss-free.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Slip-ring induction motorમાં insulated wound rotor slip rings/brushesથી external terminals સાથે જોડાય છે જેથી designed external rotor resistance starting/speedને અસર કરી શકે.

Construction / ભાગો તથા તેમનું કાર્ય

  1. Three-phase stator,laminated core/frame યોગ્ય ratings સાથે cage motor જેવા છે.
  2. Rotor slotsમાં insulated distributed windings/સામાન્ય internal star point હોય.
  3. Three slip rings,brush holders/enclosed resistance starter rotor circuit જોડે;guards rotating/live partsથી રક્ષણ આપે.
  4. Bearings,cooling/brush-lifting/shorting device actual design પ્રમાણે હોય.

Working / કારણ તથા પરિણામનો ક્રમ

  1. Approved resistance stageથી current મર્યાદિત/યોગ્ય torque મેળવો.
  2. Acceleration સાથે resistance ક્રમથી cut out કરો;normal low-loss runningમાં સામાન્ય rotor shorted હોય.
  3. Energised rotor circuit casual રીતે open નકરો;induced voltage/arcing જોખમી છે.

સમજણ તથા પરીક્ષાલક્ષી ઉપયોગ

  • Rotor સામાન્ય three-phase star connected હોય/ત્રણ ends ઉપલબ્ધ હોય;external circuit rotorનો ભાગ છે,stator supplyનો resistor નહીં.
  • Added resistance maximum-torque slip વધારે/યોગ્ય value સુધી starting torque સુધારે;power dissipate થાય એટલે speed control loss-free નથી.

title.en: 2.3 Rotating magnetic field and synchronous speed
title.gu: 2.3 Rotating Magnetic Field તથા Synchronous Speed

h.en: Rotating magnetic field and synchronous speed
h.gu: Rotating Magnetic Field તથા Synchronous Speed

body.en:
Definition

A rotating magnetic field is a magnetic-flux distribution whose spatial axis rotates around the stator;balanced sinusoidal three-phase currents in equally displaced windings ideally produce constant resultant amplitude.

Explanation and exam-ready understanding

  • One phase alone pulsates;three spatially and temporally displaced phases form a resultant rotating pattern.Reversing any two phases reverses its sequence and direction.
  • Electrical degrees are not always mechanical degrees:θe=(P/2)θm.For more poles the same supply frequency produces a lower mechanical field speed.

Assumptions and ordered derivation

  1. Assume balanced sinusoidal currents and identical sinusoidal winding distributions;each phase fundamental peak field is Fm.
  2. Summing the three displaced fields gives Fresult=(3/2)Fm cos(θe−ωet) for the chosen positive sequence;amplitude is constant.
  3. One mechanical revolution advances P/2electrical cycles,so f=(P/2)(Ns/60).Rearrange Ns=120f/P rpm.

Worked numerical / interpretation

  1. At50 Hz,2/4/6/8poles give3000/1500/1000/750 rpm field speeds.These are synchronous speeds,not guaranteed induction shaft speeds.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Rotating magnetic field એવું flux distribution છે જેની spatial axis statorની આસપાસ ફરે;equally displaced windingsનાં balanced sinusoidal currents ideal રીતે constant resultant amplitude આપે છે.

સમજણ તથા પરીક્ષાલક્ષી ઉપયોગ

  • એક phase pulsate કરે;ત્રણ spatial/time displaced phases resultant rotating pattern આપે.કોઈપણ બે phases બદલતાં sequence/direction reverse થાય.
  • Electrical/mechanical degrees હંમેશાં સમાન નથી:θe=(P/2)θm.વધુ polesમાં સમાન frequencyથી mechanical field speed ઓછી થાય.

ધારણાઓ તથા ક્રમબદ્ધ Derivation

  1. Balanced sinusoidal currents/identical winding distributions ધારો;દરેક phase fundamental peak Fm છે.
  2. ત્રણ displaced fieldsના sumથી chosen positive sequenceમાં Fresult=(3/2)Fm cos(θe−ωet) મળે;amplitude constant છે.
  3. એક mechanical revolutionમાં P/2 electrical cycles થાય,તેથી f=(P/2)(Ns/60).અતઃ Ns=120f/P rpm.

ઉકેલેલું Numerical / અર્થઘટન

  1. 50 Hz પર2/4/6/8poles માટે field speeds3000/1500/1000/750 rpm છે.આ synchronous speeds છે,guaranteed induction shaft speeds નહીં.

title.en: 2.4 Working and cage versus slip-ring comparison

h.en: Working and cage versus slip-ring comparison

body.en:
Definition

Induction-motor torque is produced by interaction of the rotating stator field with rotor currents induced by relative motion between that field and the rotor.

Explanation and exam-ready understanding

  • Lenz’s law makes the motoring rotor tend to reduce relative motion,so it accelerates in the field direction.Load torque prevents it reaching exact synchronous speed in ordinary motoring.
  • Cage:robust,low routine brush maintenance,no normal access for external rotor resistance.Slip-ring:accessible rotor resistance and starting flexibility,but added brush gear,cost and maintenance.
  • Neither type is “always better”;match load starting torque,inertia,speed range,efficiency and lifecycle servicing.VFD-fed cage motors are now common for variable-speed duties.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Induction-motor torque rotating stator field તથા field-rotor relative motionથી induced rotor currentsના interactionથી બને છે.

સમજણ તથા પરીક્ષાલક્ષી ઉપયોગ

  • Lenz’s law પ્રમાણે motoring rotor relative motion ઘટાડવા field દિશામાં accelerate કરે;ordinary motoringમાં load torqueને કારણે exact synchronous speed નથી મળતી.
  • Cage:robust/ઓછી brush maintenance,external rotor resistanceનો normal access નહીં.Slip-ring:rotor resistance/start flexibility,પણ વધુ brush gear,cost/maintenance.
  • કોઈ type હંમેશાં શ્રેષ્ઠ નથી;load starting torque,inertia,speed range,efficiency/service match કરો.Variable-speed dutiesમાં VFD-fed cage motors સામાન્ય છે.

body.en:
Definition

Slip is the relative speed of the rotating stator field with respect to the rotor,normalised by synchronous speed:s=(Ns−N)/Ns.

Explanation and exam-ready understanding

  • At standstill s=1;in forward normal motoring0<s<1;above synchronous speed s<0.The sign must be retained for generating/braking discussion.
  • Let E20 and X20 be rotor standstill per-phase EMF/reactance.Then at slip s in motoring,E2=s E20,f2=sf1,X2=s X20,and I2=s E20/√[R2²+(s X20)²].
  • Rotor displacement power factor cosφ2=R2/√[R2²+(s X20)²].At small slip rotor reactance falls and rotor power factor improves;stator power factor is not the same because magnetising current remains.

Assumptions and ordered derivation

  1. Relative rotor-field speed is Ns−N=s Ns.Frequency is proportional to relative electrical revolutions,so f2=(s Ns/Ns)f1=sf1.
  2. At fixed flux induced EMF is proportional to frequency;therefore E2=s E20 and X2=2πf2L2=s X20.
  3. Dividing rotor impedance by s gives the stator-frequency representation I2=E20/[R2/s+j X20];this is an equivalent circuit transformation,not a physical resistor of variable material.

Worked numerical / interpretation

  1. For50 Hz,4poles,N=1440 rpm:Ns=1500 rpm,s=0.04and f2=2 Hz.With R2=0.2Ω,X20=1Ω,rotor PF≈0.9806;standstill PF≈0.1961.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Slip એટલે stator rotating fieldની rotorસાપેક્ષ relative speedને synchronous speedથી normalise કરેલો ગુણોત્તર:s=(Ns−N)/Ns.

સમજણ તથા પરીક્ષાલક્ષી ઉપયોગ

  • Standstillમાં s=1;forward normal motoringમાં0<s<1;Nsથી ઉપર s<0.Generating/braking માટે sign રાખો.
  • E20/X20 rotor standstill per-phase EMF/reactance લો.Motoring slip s પર E2=s E20,f2=sf1,X2=s X20 તથા I2=s E20/√[R2²+(s X20)²].
  • Rotor displacement PF cosφ2=R2/√[R2²+(s X20)²].Small slipમાં rotor reactance ઘટી rotor PF સુધરે;magnetising currentને કારણે stator PF અલગ છે.

ધારણાઓ તથા ક્રમબદ્ધ Derivation

  1. Relative speed Ns−N=s Ns છે.Electrical relative revolutions પ્રમાણે frequency મળે,તેથી f2=(s Ns/Ns)f1=sf1.
  2. Fixed fluxમાં induced EMF frequency પ્રમાણે છે;તેથી E2=s E20 તથા X2=2πf2L2=s X20.
  3. Im pedanceને sથી divide કરતાં I2=E20/[R2/s+j X20] મળે;આ equivalent transformation છે,variable-material physical resistor નહીં.

ઉકેલેલું Numerical / અર્થઘટન

  1. 50 Hz,4poles,N=1440 rpmમાં Ns=1500 rpm,s=0.04/f2=2 Hz.R2=0.2Ω,X20=1Ω માટે running rotor PF≈0.9806;standstill PF≈0.1961.

body.en:
Definition

Slip measurement determines rotor-field relative speed either from accurately measured shaft speed and known synchronous speed or from a verified rotor/slip-frequency signal.

Explanation and exam-ready understanding

  • Tachometer:identify pole count/frequency,measure steady shaft speed using a guarded approved target,and calculate s.Do not use nameplate rpm as the measured speed.
  • Stroboscope:a stationary-looking mark can occur at harmonics/subharmonics.Use a single known mark,check adjacent flash settings and confirm with an independent speed method.
  • For a slip-ring rotor,an approved isolated rotor-frequency f2 measurement gives s=f2/f1.A galvanometer/lamp slip indication is a dedicated trainer method,not permission to attach an ordinary meter to live rings.
  • Small speed uncertainty becomes significant at small slip:δs≈−δN/Ns when f/poles are fixed.Report instrument resolution and steady-load condition.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Slip measurementમાં accurately measured shaft speed/known synchronous speed અથવા verified rotor-slip-frequency signalથી relative speed નક્કી કરાય છે.

સમજણ તથા પરીક્ષાલક્ષી ઉપયોગ

  • Tachometerમાં poles/frequency ઓળખી approved guarded targetથી steady shaft speed માપી s ગણો.Nameplate rpmને measured speed નમાનો.
  • Stroboscopeમાં harmonic/subharmonic પર પણ mark stationary લાગે.Single known mark/adjacent flash settings તપાસી independent speedથી confirm કરો.
  • Slip-ring rotorમાં approved isolated f2 measurementથી s=f2/f1 મળે.Galvanometer/lamp dedicated trainer method છે;live rings પર ordinary meter લગાવવાની મંજૂરી નહીં.
  • Small slipમાં speed uncertainty મહત્વની:fixed f/poles માટે δs≈−δN/Ns.Instrument resolution/steady-load condition લખો.

body.en:
Definition

Electromagnetic torque is the air-gap power converted per unit synchronous angular speed:Te=Pg/ωs;it is distinct from shaft torque after mechanical losses.

Explanation and exam-ready understanding

  • Use consistent rotor quantities throughout:unreferred E20,R2,X20 or an explicitly stator-referred equivalent,not a mixture.

Assumptions and ordered derivation

  1. Assume balanced steady-state motoring,constant air-gap flux and neglected stator drops for this simple rotor expression.ωs=2πNs/60.
  2. Rotor current magnitude satisfies I2²=s²E20²/[R2²+(s X20)²].Rotor copper loss is3 I2²R2=s Pg.
  3. Therefore Pg=3 I2²R2/s and Te=Pg/ωs=3 E20²s R2/[ωs(R2²+(s X20)²)].
  4. At fixed fand slip,torque is approximately proportional to voltage squared in the unsaturated fixed-parameter model;this relation is not a complete transient or VFD control law.

Worked numerical / interpretation

  1. For E20=100V,R2=0.2Ω,X20=1Ω,Ns=1500 rpm and s=0.04,Te≈36.73N·m.The result is developed torque,not shaft torque.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Electromagnetic torque air-gap powerને synchronous angular speedથી divide કરતાં મળે:Te=Pg/ωs;mechanical losses પછીના shaft torqueથી તે જુદો છે.

સમજણ તથા પરીક્ષાલક્ષી ઉપયોગ

  • Rotor quantities consistent લો:unreferred E20,R2,X20 અથવા clearly stator-referred equivalent;મિશ્રણ નહીં.

ધારણાઓ તથા ક્રમબદ્ધ Derivation

  1. Balanced steady motoring,constant air-gap flux/stator drops neglected ધારો.ωs=2πNs/60.
  2. I2²=s²E20²/[R2²+(s X20)²].Rotor copper loss3 I2²R2=s Pg છે.
  3. તેથી Pg=3 I2²R2/s તથા Te=3 E20²s R2/[ωs(R2²+(s X20)²)] મળે.
  4. Fixed f/slipમાં unsaturated fixed-parameter model મુજબ torque આશરે voltage² પ્રમાણે છે;આ complete transient/VFD control law નથી.

ઉકેલેલું Numerical / અર્થઘટન

  1. E20=100V,R2=0.2Ω,X20=1Ω,Ns=1500 rpm/s=0.04 માટે Te≈36.73N·m.આ developed torque છે,shaft torque નહીં.

h.gu: Starting,Maximum તથા Full-load Torque Ra tios

body.en:
Definition

Maximum or breakdown torque is the largest steady electromagnetic torque available on a specified torque–slip characteristic before the stable motoring operating point is lost.

Explanation and exam-ready understanding

  • Increasing rotor resistance shifts maximum torque to higher slip in the simplified model while leaving the magnitude approximately unchanged at fixed flux.It does not increase Tmax without limit.
  • The full-load torque is determined by rated operating load/speed and losses,not by setting s=1.Starting torque corresponds to s=1.

Assumptions and ordered derivation

  1. Write T=K s R2/[R2²+s²X20²],where K=3 E20²/ωs.Differentiate with respect to s at fixed parameters.
  2. Setting dT/ds=0 gives R2²−s²X20²=0,so sm=R2/X20 in motoring and Tmax=3 E20²/(2ωs X20).
  3. Hence T/Tmax=2(s/sm)/[1+(s/sm)²].At start Tst/Tmax=2sm/(1+sm²);use s=sFLfor full-load ratio.
  4. With stator Thevenin impedance included,sm=R2′/√[Rth²+(Xth+X2′)²].Do not apply the simpler condition as an exact universal law.

Worked numerical / interpretation

  1. If sm=0.2and sFL=0.04,Tst/Tmax≈0.3846and TFL/Tmax≈0.3846;the equality is incidental to these chosen values,not a rule.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Maximum/breakdown torque specified torque–slip characteristic પર ઉપલબ્ધ સૌથી મોટું steady electromagnetic torque છે,જેની આગળ stable motoring point ગુમાય છે.

સમજણ તથા પરીક્ષાલક્ષી ઉપયોગ

  • Simplified modelમાં rotor resistance વધતાં maximum torque વધુ slip પર આવે અને fixed fluxમાં magnitude આશરે સમાન રહે;Tmax અનંત નથી વધતો.
  • Full-load torque rated load/speed/lossesથી મળે,s=1થી નહીં.Starting torque માટે s=1 છે.

ધારણાઓ તથા ક્રમબદ્ધ Derivation

  1. T=K s R2/[R2²+s²X20²],K=3 E20²/ωs લો.Fixed parameters પર s પ્રમાણે differentiate કરો.
  2. dT/ds=0થી R2²−s²X20²=0 મળે;તેથી motoringમાં sm=R2/X20 તથા Tmax=3 E20²/(2ωs X20).
  3. તેથી T/Tmax=2(s/sm)/[1+(s/sm)²].Startમાં Tst/Tmax=2sm/(1+sm²);full-load માટે s=sFL લો.
  4. Stator Thevenin impedance સાથે sm=R2′/√[Rth²+(Xth+X2′)²].સરળ conditionને exact universal law નમાનો.

ઉકેલેલું Numerical / અર્થઘટન

  1. sm=0.2/sFL=0.04 હોય તો Tst/Tmax≈0.3846/TFL/Tmax≈0.3846;આ પસંદ કરેલા valuesનું પરિણામ છે,general rule નહીં.

body.en:
Definition

A torque–slip characteristic relates steady electromagnetic torque to signed slip at stated supply and machine parameters,showing motoring,generating and braking regions.

Explanation and exam-ready understanding

  • For small positive slip,T≈constant×s.On the usual stable motoring branch,load increase slows the rotor slightly,raises slip and increases torque.
  • Beyond breakdown,the available torque falls as slip rises;an overload can decelerate the motor into stall and damaging current/heating.
  • Generating slip is negative for a fixed positive field direction;plugging after phase reversal can have slip above1with respect to the newly reversed field.Define direction before using signs.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Torque–slip characteristic stated supply/parameters માટે signed slip સાથે steady torqueનો સંબંધ બતાવે છે;motoring,generating/braking regions સમજાવે છે.

સમજણ તથા પરીક્ષાલક્ષી ઉપયોગ

  • Small positive slipમાં T≈constant×s.Normal stable motoring branchમાં load વધતાં rotor થોડો ધીમો થાય/slip અને torque વધે.
  • Breakdown પછી slip વધતાં available torque ઘટે;overloadથી stall તથા damaging current/heating થઈ શકે.
  • Fixed positive fieldમાં generating slip negative છે;phase reversal પછી નવા fieldસાપેક્ષ plugging slip1થી વધુ હોઈ શકે.Sign પહેલાં direction define કરો.

title.en: 2.9 Losses and power stages:do not confuse developed/shaft power
title.gu: 2.9 Losses તથા Power Stages:Developed/Shaft Powerનો ભેદ

h.en: Losses and power stages:do not confuse developed/shaft power
h.gu: Losses તથા Power Stages:Developed/Shaft Powerનો ભેદ

body.en:
Definition

Air-gap power Pg is the electromagnetic power transferred from stator to rotor;rotor copper loss consumes s Pg and the remaining converted mechanical power is (1−s)Pg in steady induction motoring.

Explanation and exam-ready understanding

  • Pin put−stator copper/core and assigned stator losses=Pg;Pg−rotor copper=Pdev eloped;Pdev eloped−friction/windage/assigned mechanical losses=Pshaft.
  • η=Pshaft/Pin put and Tshaft=Pshaft/ωm;Te=Pg/ωs=Pdev eloped/ωmfor s≠1.Never use rotor input directly as shaft output.
  • Copper losses vary mainly with current squared;core loss depends on flux/frequency,mechanical loss on speed and construction.Stray-load loss needs an explicit test/standard allocation.

Assumptions and ordered derivation

  1. Rotor copper=3 I2²R2;air-gap input is3 I2²R2/s in the equivalent representation,so their ratio is s.
  2. Subtracting gives Pdev eloped=Pg(1−s).Since ωm=(1−s)ωs,Te=Pdev eloped/ωm=Pg/ωs.

Worked numerical / interpretation

  1. If Pg=10 kW,s=0.04and mechanical loss=0.4 kW,rotor copper=0.4 kW,developed=9.6 kW,shaft=9.2 kW.If input=11 kW,η≈83.64%.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Air-gap power Pg statorથી rotorમાં transfer થતી electromagnetic power છે;steady induction motoringમાં rotor copper loss s Pg તથા converted mechanical power (1−s)Pg થાય છે.

સમજણ તથા પરીક્ષાલક્ષી ઉપયોગ

  • Pin putમાંથી stator copper/core/assigned losses બાદ Pg;Pgમાંથી rotor copper બાદ Pdev eloped;તેમાંથી friction/windage/assigned mechanical losses બાદ Pshaft.
  • η=Pshaft/Pin put તથા Tshaft=Pshaft/ωm; s≠1 માટે Te=Pg/ωs=Pdev eloped/ωm.Rotor inputને shaft output નમાનો.
  • Copper loss મુખ્યત્વે current² સાથે બદલાય;core loss flux/frequency તથા mechanical loss speed/construction પર આધારિત.Stray-load loss માટે explicit allocation જોઈએ.

ધારણાઓ તથા ક્રમબદ્ધ Derivation

  1. Rotor copper3 I2²R2 તથા equivalent air-gap input3 I2²R2/s હોવાથી ratio s છે.
  2. Subtract કરતાં Pdev eloped=Pg(1−s).ωm=(1−s)ωs હોવાથી Te=Pg/ωs.

ઉકેલેલું Numerical / અર્થઘટન

  1. Pg=10 kW,s=0.04/mechanical loss=0.4 kWમાં rotor copper=0.4 kW,developed=9.6 kW,shaft=9.2 kW.Input=11 kW હોય તો η≈83.64%.

title.en: 2.10 Why a starter is needed:classification first

h.en: Why a starter is needed:classification first

body.en:
Definition

A motor starter is a coordinated switching/protection arrangement that starts and stops a motor and,where required,limits starting stress;it is not merely a switch or a speed controller.

Classification / scope

  • Stator methods:DOL,series stator resistance,autotransformer,star–delta and electronic soft starter.
  • Rotor resistance applies only to an appropriately accessible wound rotor;VFD starts and controls frequency/voltage and must not be confused with a voltage-only soft starter.

Construction / parts and their purpose

  1. Disconnect/short-circuit protection,contactor,overload protection,no-voltage release and emergency-stop function must be coordinated with cable,motor and installation.

Explanation and exam-ready understanding

  • At standstill rotor frequency is supply frequency and the motor presents relatively low input impedance;high inrush can cause voltage dip,heating and mechanical shock.
  • DOL applies full rated voltage and may be suitable where the supply/load permit it.Reduced-voltage starting trades lower current for lower torque;the motor must still accelerate the load.

Reliability checks and limitations

  • Overload relay is not a substitute for short-circuit protection;settings and interlocks must follow the actual approved scheme.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Motor starter coordinated switching/protection arrangement છે જે motor start/stop કરે અને જરૂરી હોય ત્યારે starting stress મર્યાદિત કરે;તે માત્ર switch/speed controller નથી.

વર્ગીકરણ / વ્યાપ

  • Stator methods:DOL,series stator resistance,autotransformer,star–delta/electronic soft starter.
  • Rotor resistance યોગ્ય accessible wound rotor માટે જ;VFD frequency/voltage control કરે,voltage-only soft starterથી જુદો છે.

Construction / ભાગો તથા તેમનું કાર્ય

  1. Disconnect/short-circuit protection,contactor,overload,no-voltage release/emergency-stopને cable,motor/installation સાથે coordinate કરો.

સમજણ તથા પરીક્ષાલક્ષી ઉપયોગ

  • Standstill પર rotor frequency supply જેટલી અને input impedance ઓછી હોવાથી high inrush,voltage dip,heating/mechanical shock થઈ શકે.
  • DOL full rated voltage આપે/supply-load મંજૂરી હોય ત્યાં યોગ્ય.Reduced-voltage startingમાં current સાથે torque પણ ઘટે;load accelerate થવો જરૂરી છે.

વિશ્વસનીયતા માટે ચકાસણી તથા મર્યાદા

  • Overload relay short-circuit protectionનો વિકલ્પ નથી;settings/interlocks approved scheme મુજબ જ.

body.en:
Definition

Reduced-voltage starting lowers the stator voltage during acceleration to reduce current,while approximately reducing starting torque by the square of the voltage ratio for the fixed-impedance comparison.

Explanation and exam-ready understanding

  • Stator resistance drops voltage and wastes power;the drop changes as current changes.It is not an efficient continuous speed regulator.
  • An autotransformer tap k supplies approximately kVto the motor;motor current is kI DOL and source current approximately k²I DOL for an ideal transformer.Comparing source and motor current without specifying the side gives wrong answers.

Assumptions and ordered derivation

  1. At unchanged locked-rotor impedance,Im otor=kI DOL and Tst art≈k²T DOL.
  2. For an ideal autotransformer,Vsource Isource≈Vmotor Im otor;therefore Isource=k Im otor=k²I DOL.Neglect magnetising/loss current only for this estimate.

Worked numerical / interpretation

  1. For k=0.8and DOL current100A,motor current≈80A,source current≈64A,and starting torque≈64%of DOL starting torque.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Reduced-voltage starting acceleration દરમિયાન stator voltage ઘટાડીને current ઓછો કરે;fixed-impedance comparisonમાં starting torque આશરે voltage ratioના square પ્રમાણે ઘટે છે.

સમજણ તથા પરીક્ષાલક્ષી ઉપયોગ

  • Stator resistance voltage drop/power loss આપે;current બદલાતાં drop બદલાય.તે efficient continuous speed regulator નથી.
  • Autotransformer tap kથી motorને આશરે kV મળે;motor current kI DOL/source current ideal રીતે k²I DOL થાય.કઈ side છે તે લખ્યા વિના current compare કરવો ખોટો છે.

ધારણાઓ તથા ક્રમબદ્ધ Derivation

  1. Locked-rotor impedance સમાન હોય તો Im otor=kI DOL/Tst art≈k²T DOL.
  2. Ideal autotransformerમાં Vsource Isource≈Vmotor Im otor;તેથી Isource=k²I DOL.આ estimateમાં જ magnetising/loss current neglect છે.

ઉકેલેલું Numerical / અર્થઘટન

  1. k=0.8/DOL current100A હોય તો motor current≈80A,source≈64A/starting torque≈64% DOL starting torque.

h.gu: Star–Delta:Connections,Ra tio તથા Ra tingની ભૂલ

body.en:
Definition

A star–delta starter initially joins the stator windings in star and subsequently reconnects them in delta;the motor must be designed for delta running at the actual line voltage and expose six suitable winding ends.

Explanation and exam-ready understanding

  • Power connections must follow U1/V1/W1and U2/V2/W2identification,not memorised physical terminal positions.Electrical plus mechanical interlocking prevents simultaneous star/delta contactor closure.
  • A400/690VΔ/Ymotor can use star–delta on400Vif otherwise suitable.A230/400VΔ/Ymotor runs in star on400V;changing it to delta there overvolts its windings.
  • Open-transition changeover can cause transient current/torque;timer setting depends on acceleration and actual scheme.The one-third torque comparison is with DOL starting torque,not rated full-load torque.

Assumptions and ordered derivation

  1. For line voltage VL,winding voltage is VL/√3in star and VL in delta.Thus winding-current ratio at fixed impedance is1/√3.
  2. Star line current equals winding current;delta line current is√3times winding current.Therefore IL Y/ILΔ=1/3.
  3. Tst art∝Vphase²therefore TY/TΔ≈1/3for the same motor,supply and locked-rotor comparison.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Star–delta starter stator windings પહેલાં star પછી deltaમાં જોડે;motor actual line voltage પર delta running-rated અને છ યોગ્ય winding endsવાળી હોવી જોઈએ.

સમજણ તથા પરીક્ષાલક્ષી ઉપયોગ

  • U1/V1/W1/U2/V2/W2 identification પ્રમાણે જોડાણ કરો,માત્ર physical terminal positions યાદથી નહીં.Electrical/mechanical interlocks simultaneous star-delta closure અટકાવે.
  • યોગ્ય400/690VΔ/Y motor400V પર star–delta વાપરી શકે.230/400VΔ/Y motor400V પર starમાં ચાલે;ત્યાં delta કરવાથી winding overvoltage થાય.
  • Open-transitionમાં transient current/torque થાય;timer acceleration/scheme પ્રમાણે સેટ થાય.One-third torque DOL starting torqueસાપેક્ષ છે,rated full-load torqueસાપેક્ષ નહીં.

ધારણાઓ તથા ક્રમબદ્ધ Derivation

  1. VL line voltageમાં star winding voltage VL/√3 અને deltaમાં VL;fixed impedanceમાં winding-current ratio1/√3.
  2. Star line current winding જેટલો/delta line current√3ગણો હોવાથી IL Y/ILΔ=1/3.
  3. Tst art∝Vphase²થી સમાન motor/supply/locked-rotor comparisonમાં TY/TΔ≈1/3.

h.en: Rotor resistance and electronic soft starter
h.gu: Rotor Resistance તથા Electronic Soft Starter

body.en:
Definition

A rotor-resistance starter inserts external resistance into a wound-rotor circuit;an electronic soft starter controls applied stator voltage during starting,usually by thyristor phase control at unchanged supply frequency.

Explanation and exam-ready understanding

  • For a slip-ring motor,choose resistance so starting current and torque suit the load,then remove it in stages.Rotor resistor thermal duty and repeated-start limits are essential.
  • A soft starter offers controlled acceleration/current limits and may use a bypass contactor after starting;it generally does not supply the wide efficient speed control of a VFD.
  • Low voltage also means low available torque;excessively slow ramps can overheat a motor that fails to accelerate.Check load inertia,starting frequency and manufacturer curve.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Rotor-resistance starter wound-rotor circuitમાં external resistance ઉમેરે;electronic soft starter સામાન્ય thyristor phase controlથી સમાન supply frequency પર starting voltage બદલે છે.

સમજણ તથા પરીક્ષાલક્ષી ઉપયોગ

  • Slip-ring motorમાં load મુજબ starting current/torque માટે resistance પસંદ કરી stagesમાં દૂર કરો.Resistor thermal duty/repeated-start limits જરૂરી.
  • Soft starter controlled acceleration/current limit આપે અને પછી bypass contactor વાપરી શકે;સામાન્ય રીતે VFD જેવી wide efficient speed control નથી આપતો.
  • Low voltageમાં torque પણ ઓછો;વધુ slow rampથી acceleration નમળે તો overheating થાય.Load inertia,starting frequency/curve તપાસો.

body.en:
Definition

Speed control deliberately changes the steady operating speed by changing synchronous speed or the slip needed to balance the load,within the motor/drive thermal and mechanical limits.

Classification / scope

  • Stator voltage,pole changing,rotor resistance and variable-voltage variable-frequency(VVVF)are the source-listed methods.

Explanation and exam-ready understanding

  • Ns=120f/Pshows frequency and pole number change field speed;rotor resistance and stator voltage mainly change slip at fixed f/P.
  • Stator-voltage control reduces torque capability approximately with V²;it can suit some fan loads but is poor for demanding constant-torque loads with excessive slip/heating.
  • Pole changing gives discrete speeds and needs a winding designed for reconnection;do not arbitrarily change links on a standard winding.
  • Rotor resistance works on slip-ring motors but dissipates slip power and gives load-dependent speed;it is not a loss-free cage-motor control.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Speed control synchronous speed અથવા load balance માટેનો slip બદલી steady speed નિયંત્રિત કરે છે,motor/drive thermal/mechanical limitsની અંદર.

વર્ગીકરણ / વ્યાપ

  • Source-listed methods:stator voltage,pole changing,rotor resistance/VVVF.

સમજણ તથા પરીક્ષાલક્ષી ઉપયોગ

  • Ns=120f/P પ્રમાણે frequency/poles field speed બદલે;rotor resistance/stator voltage fixed f/Pમાં મુખ્ય slip બદલે.
  • Stator-voltage control torque capability આશરે V² મુજબ ઘટાડે;કેટલાક fan loadsમાં યોગ્ય,વધુ slip/heatingવાળા demanding constant-torque loadમાં નબળું.
  • Pole changing discrete speeds આપે અને designed winding જોઈએ;standard windingનાં links મનફાવે તેમ નબદલો.
  • Rotor resistance slip-ringમાં slip power dissipate/load-dependent speed આપે;loss-free cage control નથી.

body.en:
Definition

A variable-frequency drive supplies adjustable-frequency,adjustable-voltage power to regulate motor speed;VVVF describes this combined adjustment rather than voltage reduction alone.

Explanation and exam-ready understanding

  • Below base frequency,a suitable V/frelationship approximately maintains flux;very-low-speed operation requires allowance for stator resistance drop and reduced self-cooling.
  • Above base speed,voltage is limited,flux weakens and available torque generally falls;an idealised constant-power region is not an unlimited overspeed permission.
  • Check inverter-rated insulation,bearing currents,EMC,cable length,dv/dtfilters,cooling and drive protection.A VFD with diode front end does not automatically regenerate energy back to the mains.

Worked numerical / interpretation

  1. A4-pole motor at25 Hz has Ns=750 rpm;at slip0.04its speed is720 rpm.Preserving an illustrative400V/50 Hz ratio suggests200V at25 Hz before low-speed compensation.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Variable-frequency drive adjustable frequency/voltage powerથી motor speed નિયંત્રિત કરે;VVVF બંને adjustment છે,માત્ર voltage reduction નહીં.

સમજણ તથા પરીક્ષાલક્ષી ઉપયોગ

  • Base frequencyની નીચે યોગ્ય V/fથી flux આશરે જળવાય;very-low speedમાં stator resistance drop/ઓછી self-coolingનો વિચાર જોઈએ.
  • Base speedથી ઉપર voltage limitથી flux નબળો/torque ઘટે;ideal constant-power region unlimited overspeedની મંજૂરી નથી.
  • Inverter-rated insulation,bearing currents,EMC,cable length,dv/dt filters,cooling/protection તપાસો.Diode-front-end VFD આપમેળે mainsમાં regeneration નથી કરતો.

ઉકેલેલું Numerical / અર્થઘટન

  1. 4-pole motor25 Hzમાં Ns=750 rpm;slip0.04 હોય તો speed720 rpm.Illustrative400V/50 Hz ratio પ્રમાણે compensation પહેલાં25 Hzમાં200V થાય.

title.en: 2.12 Induction motor as a rotating transformer

h.en: Induction motor as a rotating transformer

body.en:
Definition

An induction motor is analogous to a transformer with a rotating,short-circuited secondary:stator and rotor exchange power magnetically,but rotor frequency changes with slip and part of rotor input becomes mechanical power.

Explanation and exam-ready understanding

  • Referred per-phase circuit contains R1+j X1,a magnetising/core-loss branch,and R2′/s+j X2′.Supply voltage/current must be per-phase values for the actual star/delta connection.
  • Split R2′/s=R2′+R2′(1−s)/s.The first represents rotor copper loss;the second represents converted power in motoring,not a physically added resistor.
  • For the drawn convention V1=E1+I1(R1+j X1),I1=I0+I2′,and I0 contains core-loss and magnetising components.Induced back-EMF polarity conventions can change labels/signs,so draw the chosen arrows.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Induction motor rotating short-circuited secondaryવાળા transformer જેવો છે:stator/rotor magnetically power exchange કરે,પણ rotor frequency slip પ્રમાણે અને inputનો ભાગ mechanical power બને છે.

સમજણ તથા પરીક્ષાલક્ષી ઉપયોગ

  • Referred per-phase circuitમાં R1+j X1,magnetising/core-loss branch તથા R2′/s+j X2′ છે.Actual star/delta પ્રમાણે per-phase V/I લો.
  • R2′/s=R2′+R2′(1−s)/s કરો.પહેલો rotor copper loss/બીજો motoring converted power દર્શાવે,physical added resistor નહીં.
  • Drawn conventionમાં V1=E1+I1(R1+j X1),I1=I0+I2′ અને I0માં core-loss/magnetising components છે.Back-EMF polarity મુજબ labels/signs બદલાય,તેથી arrows define કરો.

body.en:
Definition

A phasor diagram represents sinusoidal steady-state voltages/currents by directed complex vectors at a common reference frequency;it is not a literal physical layout of the machine.

Explanation and exam-ready understanding

  • Take E1 as horizontal reference;I2′lags E1 by the rotor-equivalent impedance angle,while magnetising current mainly lags the air-gap voltage by90°.
  • Add Ic and Im vectorially to obtain I0,then add I2′to get I1.Add in-phase resistance drop and quadrature leakage-reactance drop to obtain V1.
  • At light load,magnetising current is a large fraction of input current,so stator power factor is often low even though rotor frequency is small.Do not add magnitudes arithmetically.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Phasor diagram common reference frequency પર sinusoidal steady voltages/currentsને directed complex vectorsથી બતાવે છે;તે machineનું physical layout નથી.

સમજણ તથા પરીક્ષાલક્ષી ઉપયોગ

  • E1 horizontal reference લો;I2′ E1થી rotor-equivalent impedance angleથી lag થાય,magnetising current air-gap voltageથી મુખ્ય90°lag થાય.
  • Ic/Imનો vector sum I0,પછી I2′ઉમેરી I1 મેળવો.Resistance drop તથા quadrature leakage drop ઉમેરી V1 મેળવો.
  • Light loadમાં magnetising currentનો fraction મોટો હોવાથી rotor frequency ઓછી હોવા છતાં stator PF ઓછો હોઈ શકે.Magnitudesનો arithmetic sum નકરો.

h.en: No-load and blocked-rotor tests:what can be identified
h.gu: No-load/Blocked-Rotor Te stsથી શું જાણી શકાય?

body.en:
Definition

A no-load test estimates the magnetising/fixed-loss behaviour of a running motor;an approved reduced-voltage blocked-rotor test estimates the combined series impedance at the stated test frequency and temperature.

Explanation and exam-ready understanding

  • For no load,P0includes stator copper,iron,friction/windage and a small rotor copper loss.It is incorrect to call all P0iron loss.
  • At blocked rotor use phase values:Zeq=Vsc,ph/Isc,ph,Req=Psc/(3Isc,ph²),Xeq=√(Zeq²−Req²).Measure R1 appropriately to estimate R2′=Req−R1.
  • X1 and X2′are not separately determined by these readings alone;an equal split is an explicit design approximation.Core loss is often neglected at low blocked-rotor voltage,not proved zero.
  • Separating iron and mechanical loss needs additional evidence,for example a carefully permitted no-load voltage series with nearly constant speed,corrected copper loss and stated extrapolation assumptions.

Worked numerical / interpretation

  1. In a star-connected test,Vsc,line=50V,Isc,line=10A,Psc=500Wand R1=0.5Ωgive Zeq≈2.8868Ω,Req≈1.6667Ω,Xeq≈2.3570Ω,R2′≈1.1667Ω.All are illustrative calculated values,not measurements.

વ્યાખ્યા

No-load test running motorનું magnetising/fixed-loss behaviour estimate કરે;approved reduced-voltage blocked-rotor test stated frequency/temperature પર combined series impedance આપે છે.

સમજણ તથા પરીક્ષાલક્ષી ઉપયોગ

  • No-load P0માં stator copper,iron,friction/windage તથા નાનું rotor copper છે.બધું P0 iron loss નકહો.
  • Blocked rotorમાં phase valuesથી Zeq=Vsc,ph/Isc,ph,Req=Psc/(3Isc,ph²),Xeq=√(Zeq²−Req²).R1 માપીને R2′=Req−R1 estimate કરો.
  • માત્ર આ readingsથી X1/X2′અલગ મળતા નથી;equal split explicit approximation છે.Low-voltage blocked testમાં core loss ઘણીવાર neglected છે,zero સાબિત નથી.
  • Iron/mechanical loss અલગ કરવા additional evidence જોઈએ;જેમ કે near-constant speedવાળી permitted no-load voltage series,copper correction/extrapolation assumptions.

ઉકેલેલું Numerical / અર્થઘટન

  1. Star testમાં Vsc,line=50V,Isc,line=10A,Psc=500W/R1=0.5Ωથી Zeq≈2.8868Ω,Req≈1.6667Ω,Xeq≈2.3570Ω/R2′≈1.1667Ω મળે.આ illustrative calculations છે,measurements નહીં.

body.en:
Definition

An induction-motor circle diagram is an approximate graphical current locus obtained under a fixed-parameter equivalent-circuit model;test data and loss separation are needed to interpret power,torque and efficiency.

Explanation and exam-ready understanding

  • Declare axes:horizontal active current Ix,vertical positive lagging reactive current Iy,with supply-voltage reference along Ix.For balanced tests,cosφ=P/(√3 VL IL).
  • Plot A=(I0 cosφ0,I0 sinφ0).Scale blocked-rotor current to rated voltage only under the stated impedance assumption:Ibr*=Ibr(Vrated/Vbr),then plot Bfrom its angle.
  • In the simple locus the centre lies on the line through Aparallel to the reactive-current axis.Intersect this line with the perpendicular bisector of ABto obtain centre C;draw the circle through Aand B.
  • For this axis convention,Cx=Axand Cy=Ay+[(Bx−Ax)²+(By−Ay)²]/[2(By−Ay)],if By≠Ay.This checks the geometry,not full motor accuracy.
  • The ABchord is the approximate zero-output reference in the usual ideal construction;separate torque/loss lines require stator/rotor copper and fixed-loss allocation from the chosen textbook convention.Label current scale,power scale,operating point and every loss line.
  • Saturation,skin effect,temperature,stray loss and changing magnetising current limit accuracy.Do not report a circle-drawn efficiency as a measured shaft efficiency.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Induction-motor circle diagram fixed-parameter equivalent modelનું approximate graphical current locus છે;power,torque/efficiency માટે test data/loss separation જોઈએ.

સમજણ તથા પરીક્ષાલક્ષી ઉપયોગ

  • Axes define કરો:horizontal active Ix/vertical positive lagging reactive Iy;voltage Ixદિશામાં.Balanced testમાં cosφ=P/(√3 VL IL).
  • A=(I0 cosφ0,I0 sinφ0) plot કરો.Stated impedance assumptionમાં જ Ibr*=Ibr(Vrated/Vbr) કરીને Bતેના angleથી plot કરો.
  • Simple locusમાં centre,Aમાંથી reactive-current axisને parallel line પર હોય.ABના perpendicular bisector સાથે intersection Cમેળવી A/Bવર્તુળ દોરો.
  • આ axesમાં Cx=Ax/Cy=Ay+[(Bx−Ax)²+(By−Ay)²]/[2(By−Ay)] છે,જો By≠Ay.આ geometry check છે,full motor accuracy નહીં.
  • Usual ideal constructionમાં AB approximate zero-output reference છે;torque/loss lines માટે chosen convention મુજબ copper/fixed-loss allocation જોઈએ.Current/power scale,operating point/દરેક line label કરો.
  • Saturation,skin effect,temperature,stray loss/changing magnetising current accuracy મર્યાદિત કરે.Circle-derived efficiencyને measured shaft efficiency નકહો.

h.gu: Line/Phase Quantities તથા Te st Power

body.en:
Definition

A per-phase equivalent circuit represents one winding phase of a balanced machine;line instruments must be converted according to the actual winding connection before circuit parameters are calculated.

Explanation and exam-ready understanding

  • Star:Vph=VL/√3and Iph=IL.Delta:Vph=VL and Iph=IL/√3.Balanced total P=3VphIphcosφ=√3 VL IL cosφ.
  • Two-wattmeter total power is the algebraic sum W1+W2;one reading can be negative at low PF.The tangent relation requires balanced sinusoidal conditions and the declared meter convention.
  • PF inferred above1,negative passive series resistance or Xeq²<0is an inconsistency to investigate,not a value to silently clip.Examine polarity,ranges,connection,units and test temperature.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Per-phase equivalent balanced machineની એક winding phase બતાવે છે;parameters પહેલાં line readings actual connection પ્રમાણે convert કરવાનાં છે.

સમજણ તથા પરીક્ષાલક્ષી ઉપયોગ

  • Star:Vph=VL/√3/Iph=IL.Delta:Vph=VL/Iph=IL/√3.Balanced total P=3VphIphcosφ=√3 VL IL cosφ.
  • Two-wattmeter total W1+W2નો algebraic sum છે;low PFમાં એક reading negative થઈ શકે.Tangent relation balanced sinusoidal conditions/meter conventionમાં જ.
  • PF 1થી વધુ,passive resistance negative/Xeq²<0 હોય તો inconsistency તપાસવી,મનસ્વી clip નહીં.Polarity,ranges,connection,units/temperature જુઓ.

title.en: 2.13 Four-quadrant operation and where the energy goes

h.en: Four-quadrant operation and where the energy goes

body.en:
Definition

Four-quadrant operation describes the four combinations of signed shaft speed and electromagnetic torque;mechanical converted power has sign Pm=Teωm in the declared convention.

Explanation and exam-ready understanding

  • With horizontal speed and vertical torque:Q1positive speed/positive torque and Q3negative speed/negative torque are motoring;Q2negative speed/positive torque and Q4positive speed/negative torque are braking.
  • Regenerative braking returns mechanical energy electrically when the machine and converter/supply support it.Plugging dissipates energy and can also draw supply power;DC injection braking is another dissipative method.
  • A braking quadrant alone does not prove mains regeneration.A brake resistor or active front end may be required;phase-reversal stopping requires approved interlocks and zero-speed action.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Four-quadrant operation signed shaft speed/electromagnetic torqueનાં ચાર combinations બતાવે;declared conventionમાં Pm=Teωmનો sign મહત્વનો છે.

સમજણ તથા પરીક્ષાલક્ષી ઉપયોગ

  • Horizontal speed/vertical torqueમાં Q1 positive/positive તથા Q3 negative/negative motoring;Q2 negative speed/positive torque તથા Q4 positive speed/negative torque braking છે.
  • Machine/converter/supply support કરે તો regeneration mechanical energy electrically પરત આપે.Pluggingમાં energy dissipate થાય તથા supply power પણ લઈ શકે;DC injection પણ dissipative છે.
  • માત્ર braking quadrantથી mains regeneration સાબિત નથી થતું.Brake resistor/active front end જરૂરી હોઈ શકે;phase-reversal stopping માટે approved interlocks/zero-speed action જોઈએ.

title.gu: 2.14 Load મુજબ Motor Selection તથા Acceleration

h.gu: Load મુજબ Motor Selection તથા Acceleration

body.en:
Definition

Load matching compares motor torque,load torque,inertia and duty over the entire required speed trajectory,not only the rated kW printed on a nameplate.

Explanation and exam-ready understanding

  • Constant-torque conveyors need torque throughout acceleration;centrifugal fans/pumps approximately follow Tload∝N²and P∝N³over an appropriate similar operating range.
  • Acceleration follows J dω/dt=Te−Tload−Tloss.Check high inertia,frequent starts,braking energy and thermal recovery;oversizing may worsen light-load PF and lifecycle cost.
  • Compare supply compatibility,starting limits,speed range,ambient/altitude,IP/IC/IM ratings,shaft/coupling alignment,protection and verified efficiency at useful load.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Load matchingમાં required speed trajectoryમાં motor torque,load torque,inertia/duty compare થાય;માત્ર nameplate kW નહીં.

સમજણ તથા પરીક્ષાલક્ષી ઉપયોગ

  • Constant-torque conveyorને accelerationભર torque જોઈએ;યોગ્ય similar rangeમાં centrifugal fan/pump માટે Tload∝N²/P∝N³આશરે લાગુ પડે.
  • Acceleration J dω/dt=Te−Tload−Tloss પ્રમાણે છે.High inertia,frequent starts,braking energy/thermal recovery તપાસો;oversizing light-load PF/lifecycle cost બગાડી શકે.
  • Supply,starting limits,speed range,ambient/altitude,IP/IC/IM,shaft-coupling alignment,protection/ઉપયોગી load પર efficiency compare કરો.

body.en:
Definition

A motor specification is a coordinated statement of electrical,thermal,mechanical and environmental ratings and applicable test standards;an efficiency label alone is not a complete specification.

Explanation and exam-ready understanding

  • IEC 60034series covers rotating-machine performance/testing and codes;IEC 60072addresses dimensions;IP,IC and IM identify enclosure protection,cooling and mounting—not interchangeable ratings.
  • IS12615:2018is a relevant Indian line-operated three-phase motor efficiency/performance reference;check current BISamendments,product scope and mandatory requirements instead of assuming every motor is covered.
  • IEC 60034-30-1:2025introduces formal IE5 limits for its line-operated motor scope,replacing the2014edition.IE1/IE2/IE3/IE4/IE5 are efficiency classes,not a speed-controller guarantee or a total drive-system efficiency.
  • NEMA MG1 uses its own frame/design/service-factor practices;an IE/NEMA comparison needs matching frequency,poles,power,tests and dimensions.Frame labels or service factors must not be assumed identical.
  • Read rated V,Δ/Y,A,kW,Hz,rpm,PF,η,duty,insulation temperature class,IP and mounting;voltage/frequency ratios and winding links must match the real supply.

Reliability checks and limitations

  • Standards are edition-dependent introductory references,not a reproduced certification table.No universal minimum IEclass or legally valid procurement decision is inferred from these notes.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Motor specification electrical,thermal,mechanical/environmental ratings તથા applicable testsનું coordinated statement છે;માત્ર efficiency label પૂરતું specification નથી.

સમજણ તથા પરીક્ષાલક્ષી ઉપયોગ

  • IEC 60034 series performance/testing/codes તથા IEC 60072 dimensions માટે છે;IP,IC/IM અનુક્રમે protection,cooling/mounting છે,interchangeable ratings નહીં.
  • IS12615:2018 Indian line-operated three-phase motor efficiency/performance reference છે;current BIS amendments,scope/mandatory requirements તપાસો,દરેક motor covered નમાનો.
  • IEC 60034-30-1:2025એ તેની line-operated scopeમાં formal IE5 limits ઉમેર્યાં/2014edition replace કરી.IE1/IE2/IE3/IE4/IE5 efficiency classes છે,speed-controller/total drive-system efficiency નહીં.
  • NEMA MG1નાં frame/design/service-factor practices જુદા છે;IE/NEMA comparisonમાં frequency,poles,power,test/dimensions match કરો.Frame labels/service factor સમાન નધારો.
  • Ra ted V,Δ/Y,A,kW,Hz,rpm,PF,η,duty,insulation class,IP/mounting વાંચો;V/f/links real supply સાથે match કરવાના.

વિશ્વસનીયતા માટે ચકાસણી તથા મર્યાદા

  • Standards edition-dependent introductory references છે,certification tableની copy નહીં.આ notes પરથી universal minimum IE/legal procurement decision નકરો.

body.en:
Definition

Condition-based maintenance uses measured trends and inspection evidence to judge machine health and schedule action,instead of replacing parts solely because one unverified reading looks unusual.

Explanation and exam-ready understanding

  • Trend phase currents,voltage balance,temperature,vibration,bearing noise and insulation with the operating load/ambient recorded.Unbalance and single-phasing can create damaging heating.
  • Isolated inspection checks terminals,earth,fan path,bearings,coupling/belts and slip-ring brush gear if present;lubrication type/quantity follow the manufacturer,not “more grease is better”.
  • Before insulation testing,isolate VFD,electronics,surge devices and connected instruments per procedure.Record temperature and test voltage;never apply a blanket megger test through a drive.
  • If a motor trips repeatedly,identify load,supply,cooling and protection causes;do not bypass overload/earth protection or keep resetting a stalled motor.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Condition-based maintenance measured trends/inspection evidenceથી machine health/action નક્કી કરે;એક unverified readingથી parts બદલતું નથી.

સમજણ તથા પરીક્ષાલક્ષી ઉપયોગ

  • Load/ambient સાથે phase currents,voltage balance,temperature,vibration,bearing noise/insulation trends લો.Unbalance/single-phasing damaging heating આપી શકે.
  • Isolated inspectionમાં terminals,earth,fan path,bearings,coupling/belts/slip-ring gear જુઓ.Lubrication type/quantity manufacturer મુજબ;વધુ grease હંમેશાં સારું નહીં.
  • Insulation test પહેલાં VFD,electronics,surge devices/instruments procedure પ્રમાણે isolate કરો.Te mperature/test voltage લખો;driveમાંથી blanket megger test નહીં.
  • Repeated tripમાં load,supply,cooling/protection cause શોધો;overload/earth protection bypass કે stalled motorનું repeated reset નકરો.

q.en: Meaning of s=0.04?

a.en: Relative field-to-rotor speed is4%of synchronous speed,not4%of shaft speed.
a.gu: Relative speed synchronous speedના4%છે,shaft speedના4% નહીં.

q.en: Rotor frequency at standstill?

a.en: Equal to stator supply frequency in the induction model.

q.en: Why not exact Ns at normal motoring?

a.en: Relative motion is needed to induce the rotor current required for load torque.
a.gu: Load torque માટે rotor current induce કરવા relative motion જોઈએ.

q.en: Rotor versus stator PF?

a.en: No;stator input also contains magnetising/core-loss current.
a.gu: નહીં;stator inputમાં magnetising/core-loss current પણ છે.

q.en: Slip power loss?
Maximum torque resistance effect?

a.en: In the simple fixed-flux model,added rotor resistance raises the peak-slip location while Tmax is approximately unchanged.
a.gu: Simple fixed-flux modelમાં resistanceથી peak slip વધે/Tmaxઆશરે સમાન રહે.

q.en: Star-delta one-third relative to what?

a.en: Line starting current and starting torque relative to direct delta starting at the same line voltage.
a.gu: સમાન line voltage પર direct delta startingના line current/starting torqueની સરખામણી.

a.en: Normally delta running,so star–delta may be suitable if load/terminals/ratings permit.
a.gu: સામાન્ય delta running;load/terminals/ratings મંજૂરી હોય તો star–delta યોગ્ય હોઈ શકે.

q.en: Soft starter equals VFD?

a.en: No;soft starting mainly changes voltage at supply frequency,while VFD changes frequency and voltage.
a.gu: નહીં;soft starter મુખ્ય fixed-frequency voltage/VFD frequency-voltage બદલે.

q.en: No-load power all iron loss?

a.en: No;it includes stator copper,mechanical and other small losses.
a.gu: નહીં;stator copper,mechanical/બીજા નાના losses પણ છે.

q.en: Stroboscope stationary image reliable alone?

a.en: No;harmonic/subharmonic aliases need checks and independent confirmation.

q.en: IE5 always a whole drive efficiency?

a.en: No;the cited motor standard scope/test applies,not automatically the converter/cables/system.
a.gu: નહીં;cited motor scope/test લાગુ,converter/cables/systemને આપમેળે નહીં.
